what_is_wrong: The source atlas depicts only five clear walk key poses despite its Walk (6) label. Frame six uses the illustrated fifth upper body and first lower-body pose as an articulated interpolation; needs visual approval.

Generated multi-action atlas contains individual figures approximately 30–55 native pixels tall, below the requested >=80px source target. The strips are valid pixel-art prototypes; fine weapons/armor details may be weaker than B0 Warrior.

Some standing views vary from 148 px despite one fixed per-class scaling factor: Rogue 148-152 px, Warlock 144-148 px, Paladin 144-152 px. Adjust one fixed per-view game scale or redraw; per-frame resizing was deliberately not used.
Some attack/cast poses from the illustrated source are small, so dagger, staff, or hammer silhouettes may not read clearly in EVERY frame. Review at gameplay scale before production approval.
Weapon-effect spawn coordinates in the manifest are approximations and need in-engine adjustment.
B2 source atlas has a different native detail level from B0 and some frames have near-identical walk/idle silhouette. Art refinement is recommended if B0 fidelity is mandatory.
